# Off Duty SOP We at NT hope you enjoy your time off and enjoy the many facilitys on your station. This is the small list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#388c34]Off Duty Personnel[/color] of this station.
1. While you are Off Duty you are not allowed to use restricted equipment from your department if you wish to make use of your departments equipment head to hop and get a permit or request to get back on shift.
